== Description ==

Players around a table in a meeting room at the Hyatt Regency Peachtree on 17 October 2022, the Monday after the [[2022 World Championship]] in Atlanta. The photograph is a selfie; the man in the maroon T-shirt and grey cap in the foreground posted it. None of the faces are yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-2022, jarjardrinks, 17 October 2022 (14:35 Eastern). Original file name: image_from_ios.jpg (4032×3024); Slack file id F046VR22U67.
* '''Shared by:''' jarjardrinks (Slack)
* '''Date:''' 17 October 2022 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' The man in the maroon T-shirt, glasses and grey cap in the immediate foreground is the photographer (Slack: jarjardrinks); his legal name is not yet dested. The other players are not yet identified.

Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
